pm_ajay.full_name: PM-AJAY (Pradhan Mantri Anusuchit Jaati Abhyuday Yojana)
pm_ajay.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE)
pm_ajay.target_beneficiaries: Scheduled Caste (SC) families below poverty line
pm_ajay.description: PM-AJAY consolidates three legacy SC welfare schemes (SPADP, PMSSI, PMKVY-SC) into a single umbrella for skill development, asset subsidy, and credit linkage for SC beneficiaries.

skill_training_gia.name: Skill Training via GIA (Grant-in-Aid)
includes: Free training at approved skill centers
skill_training_gia.duration_range: 3 months to 12 months depending on trade
skill_training_gia.certification: NSQF Level 2 to Level 4 certificates recognized by NCVET

asset_subsidy.name: Asset/Tool Subsidy for Self-Employment
asset_subsidy.description: Up to ₹50,000 or 50% of asset cost (whichever is less) for purchasing productive assets like sewing machines, e-rickshaws, dairy equipment, or agri-tools.

nsfdc_micro_finance.name: NSFDC Micro Finance Scheme
nsfdc_micro_finance.for: Small income-generating activities and working capital

SEED.for: Rural SC families with land access

WOW.description: SC women drive e-rickshaws funded by asset subsidy and NSFDC loan. Earn as delivery partner or passenger transport.

application_process.offline: Visit nearest DRDA/Block Development Office or SC Welfare District Office with Aadhaar, caste certificate, income certificate
application_process.online: Apply at https://socialjustice.gov.in or via CSC (Common Service Centre) in your village
